An End to Slavery

Fearing the approaching Kanians, Firez is moving his June prisoners from the mountain prison to his castle. Intercepting the convoy offers a real chance to free your family.

Objectives

Intercept the convoy

Free the prisoners

Escort the June to safety

All June must survive

Locations

Maps
Sadrok and its surroundings
